mapper.select: select tab_id, project_id, owner_user_id, visibility, tab_name, preset, config_json, tab_sort, create_time, update_time from sys_project_workbench_tabs where project_id = #{projectId} and (visibility = 'project' or (visibility = 'private' and owner_user_id = #{userId})) order by case when visibility = 'project' then 0 else 1 end, coalesce(tab_sort, 0) desc, create_time desc
select tab_id, project_id, owner_user_id, visibility, tab_name, preset, config_json, tab_sort, create_time, update_time from sys_project_workbench_tabs where tab_id = #{tabId}
select count(1) from sys_project_workbench_tabs where project_id = #{projectId} and visibility = 'project'
